name: Kisaragi Akane
source:
The youngest of the three Kisaragi sisters, a first-year student at an all girls' school. Akane has a bright and cheerful personality and is worried about her childish looks.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3378]Getchu[/url].]
